data_provenance.modded_installation: The installation carries the BSPRM mod and a HUD mod (xlive.dll is AlterBSP). mod_restore.bat restores interface, movies, mpak, sound and the exe and never touches scripts/. The three reconclasses.lua files carry the 2024-07-13 08:26 timestamp shared by the untouched datatables; gamemode.lua, vehicleclasses.lua, shipnames.lua and three classtables files carry later timestamps. No pristine copy was available to diff against, so 'install baseline' here means 'same timestamp as the untouched bulk', not 'byte-identical to the retail release'.
data_provenance.extraction: local/extract_reconclasses.py evaluates the Lua subset these files use (scalar assignments, table constructors, + - * /, DEG()) with COL_* from scripts/global/luamw_init.lua lines 22-28 and DEG from line 434, then applies 008082A0's arithmetic in float32.
data_provenance.variant_difference: The arcade and realistic files are identical except for the table name and fifteen base-range scalars; every row, key and structure is the same.

corrections.evidence: 008087a4 MOV EAX,[ESP+10h] (observer) / 008087ac LEA EAX,[EAX+EAX*2] / 008087af SHL EAX,5 / 008087b2 LEA EDI,[EAX+ECX+5Ch] is record + 8 + observer*60h + 7*0Ch, the eighth header of the group; 00808903 pushes the ring into it. 008048A0 never reads it, which is what 'unreachable' should have said.

corrections.was: the Color values in GUIRange are Lua constants that this packet did not decode, so the four colour words are left zero
